info.title: Myme API
info.description: Typed data layer for structured personal data

bearerAuth.description: Pass an API key (myme_k1_...) or OAuth access token (myme_at_...)

post.summary: Create an item

get.summary: List items with filtering and pagination

patch.summary: Update an item with conflict detection

post.summary: Restore a trashed item
Transition item state

get.summary: List version history for an item

post.summary: Add tags to an item

delete.summary: Permanently delete a trashed item (admin only)
Remove a tag from an item

post.summary: Create or upsert many items in one call (admin only). Replaces /import.
Apply one action to every item matching a filter.

400.description: Validation error, missing confirm, or cap exceeded

get.summary: List all extension namespaces for an item

put.summary: Write to a specific extension namespace (100KB limit)

get.summary: List outbound edges from an item
List inbound edges (backrefs) targeting an item
List all edges across the tenant, filtered by edge type

schema.description: Comma-separated edge types. Up to 10 entries. Omit to list every edge.

parameters.description: Comma-separated edge types. Up to 10 entries. Omit to list every edge.
parameters.name: edge_type

400.description: Validation error (e.g. too many edge types in filter)

post.summary: Create a single edge

404.description: Source, target, or edge type not found

patch.summary: Update edge properties (edge_type, source_id, target_id are immutable)

post.summary: Create or upsert many edges in one call (admin only). Parallel to /items/bulk.
Register a custom edge type (admin)

400.description: Can't delete a core edge type

get.description: Returns all registered types including core and custom types.

post.summary: Register a custom type
post.description: Register a new custom type schema. Admin keys bypass; non-admin credentials need the `metadata.types:write` scope (default-off for new keys). Body is validated via validateTypeSchema().

put.description: Update an existing custom type schema. Admin only. Core types cannot be modified. Body is validated via validateTypeSchema().

delete.description: Delete a custom type. Admin only. Core types cannot be deleted. Use ?force=true to delete even if items exist.

get.summary: Enumerate distinct tags in use across visible items

200.description: Distinct tags with usage counts, sorted by count descending then tag ascending. Tenant-scoped; type-permission scoped; trashed items excluded.

post.summary: Upload a blob (multipart or raw binary)

get.summary: Get a presigned download URL for a blob

400.description: Invalid blob hash or presigned URLs not available

post.summary: Remove unreferenced blobs (admin only)
Reconcile blob storage against database (admin only)
post.description: Compares the blob storage backend against the database to find orphaned files (in storage but not DB) and missing files (in DB but not storage). Defaults to dry_run=true for safety.

post.summary: Create a new API key
post.description: Creates a new API key. In bootstrap mode (zero keys exist), no auth is required and the key is always admin.

patch.summary: Update an API key in place
patch.description: Updates mutable fields on an API key. `source` and `role` are immutable after creation and rejected with 400 if present. Admin only.

400.description: Invalid update (e.g. attempt to mutate an immutable field)

post.summary: Mint a per-Connection runtime credential (control-plane lease broker only)

201.description: Runtime credential minted. The api_key is returned ONCE and never again.

get.summary: Look up inbound webhook subscriptions for a Connection — control-plane only

post.summary: Register a new Integration manifest (platform credential only)

201.description: Integration registered. Subsequent versions register as sibling items.

get.summary: Get one registered Integration by id

get.description: Admin only. Returns tenant-scoped config (per-type feed retention overrides). An empty object is returned when nothing is configured.

put.description: Admin only. Overwrites the tenant's config with the supplied object. Validates that retention type IDs resolve in the registry.

post.summary: Restore items and blobs from a myme-archive-v1 tar.gz (admin only)

get.summary: Streaming NDJSON or archive export with filters

200.description: Streaming NDJSON export of items with metadata (or archive when format=archive)

post.summary: Register an inbound webhook subscription on a connection

201.description: Subscription created. The `secret` field is returned ONCE; subsequent reads redact it.

get.summary: List inbound webhook subscriptions on a connection
List recent receipts for an inbound webhook subscription

post.summary: Reset an event row for manual replay from DLQ

200.description: Event row reset; back in the pending queue

404.description: Connection, subscription, or event not found

post.summary: Issue a short-TTL bearer token for a manifest-declared capability

201.description: Lease issued. The `lease_token` field is returned ONCE; subsequent reads omit it.

400.description: Invalid input or TTL out of range

422.description: Manifest doesn't declare the capability as leased

get.summary: List active leases for a connection

post.summary: Revoke a leased token mid-flight
Introspect a leased token (RFC 7662-shaped)

200.description: Active flag plus lease metadata when active. Returns 200 with `active: false` for unknown / expired / revoked leases.

post.summary: Receive a signed payload from an external service (public)
Create a new webhook

get.summary: List recent delivery attempts for a webhook
